Let's translate roughly.

Option 1: "دست هر کس را گرفتم صائب از افتادگان - بر چراغ زندگی دست حمایت شد مرا"
Rough: "I took each person's hand, Saib (maybe poet) from the fallen - on the lamp of life, my hand was supported." Something about helping others, support, life lamp.

Option 2: "خاکساری پیشه خود کن که من چون آفتاب - در نظرها سربلند از جبهه فرسایی شدم"
Rough: "Make your profession humble (soil?) because I, like the sun - in the eyes I became lofty from the frontier of ...?" Not clear. Possibly about humility vs greatness.

Option 3: "مگذر عبرت عبرت صائب که خورشید بلند - شبنم افتاده را در دیده خود جا دهد"
Rough: "Do not pass (ignore) the lesson of Saib that the sun is high - the dew of the fallen finds place in its own eye." Something about lessons, sun, dew.

Option 4: "نیست اکسیری به عالم بهتر از افتادگی - قطره ناچیز گردد گوهر از افتادگی"
Rough: "There is no better remedy for the world than falling (humility) - a tiny drop becomes a gem from falling." So concept about falling/humility leading to transformation.

All seem to involve "افتادگی" (falling, humility). Option 2 maybe less about falling? It mentions "خاکساری پیشه خود کن که من چون آفتاب" maybe about humility vs sun. Could still involve falling? Not explicit.

Option 1 mentions "از افتادگان" (from the fallen). Option 3 mentions "افتاده". Option 4 mentions "افتادگی". Option 2 does not contain "افتاد" word. So concept difference: Option 2 is about humility in profession vs sun, not about falling. So likely outlier.

Thus answer: 2.
